_meta.title: Cannith Challenge (Vaults of the Artificers) upgrade-tier enchantments
_meta.source: ddowiki.com item pages, same-origin paced harvest per docs/wiki-evidence/harvest-method.md
_meta.why: gear-planner emits NO enchantments for a Vaults item whose wiki page uses the 'Upgradeable - Tier N' layout; it emits only a marker affix (VotAU on worn gear, 'Upgradeable - Tier' on weapons). 97 of the 140 Vaults variants are stat-less as a result. This shard covers the 33 WORN variants; the 64 weapon variants are tracked separately (see _meta.weapons_deferred).
_meta.scope: Worn gear AND the 80 Vaults weapon variants. The worn entries carry resolved affixes AND slots; the weapon entries are `admit: slots_only` — the tier-granted augment slot and nothing else, per #591's re-scope. Their bane and proc enchantments stay unvalued permanently (#331, closed not-planned).
_meta.weapons_deferred: RESOLVED 2026-09-18 by #591 half B. The 80 weapon variants (18 families) are harvested and in this shard. Their tier text came from the PER-VARIANT item pages, not the family pages' {{Turnin}} wikitext the 2026-09-06 mapping described: every variant has its own page carrying the same rendered Enchantments block the worn entries use, which is what `raw_is_authoritative` below has always asked for. That route needs no wikitext and no clipboard paste, because rendered text carries no template pipes. scripts/browser/harvest_cannith_weapon_variants.js is what ran; harvest_cannith_weapon_families.js is kept for the full per-(level, tier) matrix, which this does not supersede.
_meta.tier_choice: final - the fully-upgraded Tier 3 state. Matches the project's founding position that theoretical best-in-slot assumes access to everything (README, and the attainability non-goal in AGENTS.md). Every tier's raw text is kept below so a different choice never needs a re-harvest.
_meta.raw_is_authoritative: `raw` is the verbatim rendered Enchantments block, tier headers included, with ' / ' separating lines. `final` is DERIVED from it by src/cannith_tiers.py, and tests/test_cannith_tiers.py re-derives every entry and fails on any disagreement - so a hand-edited `final` cannot ship.
_meta.slots_are_capacity: #591 (2026-09-14): `slots` is the augment-slot capacity each fully-upgraded item carries, as `crafting[]` labels (`Green Augment Slot`), DERIVED from `raw` by src/cannith_tiers.resolve_slots and re-derived by the tests. An augment slot is a host field, not an affix - the overlay appends these to the record's own crafting[] so the existing lift (planner_items) and colour normalization (colors) run unchanged. Before this they were quarantined as 'augment slot, not an affix', which was true and left 40 wiki-stated slots on the floor.
_meta.weapons_measured: 80 variants, 0 pages missing, 0 refused for carrying guard characters. 64 grant a slot; the other 16 are the level-4 rows, which are not upgradeable and correctly derive none — kept in the shard rather than dropped so their raw proves the absence. 80 labels, not 64: the 16 Epic variants add a Colorless slot at Tier 2 AND a Purple at Tier 3, which #591's body did not anticipate (it named Purple only). Cross-check: the family pages' Turnin rows independently show 4 Purple rows per family, on Tier 3 of levels 8/12/16/Epic, and level 4 with no tier at all — two sources, same answer.
_meta.slots_only: #591 half B. A weapon entry admits its augment slot and NOT the enchantments its own `raw` would yield (315 affix instances across the 80: Enhancement Bonus on all 80, the four Elemental Resistances, and ~215 bane/proc presence flags). The issue puts them out of scope twice and asks for a separate follow-up rather than folding them in. `test_every_final_is_rederived_from_its_own_raw` honours the marker AND guards it: an entry whose raw derives nothing cannot declare slots_only, so the marker can never decorate an empty harvest, and it must state a reason.

The cut is by TYPE, not by whether a line carries a number: `Dragon Bane 3` has a magnitude and resolves to `Bool`, because it is bane damage vs a creature type — the family #331 closed as permanently unvalued, and this optimizer does not score it. What is admitted is the four Elemental Resistances — one spelling each, slot-independent — typed from a gear-planner sibling or the catalog-wide uniform type, never from the wiki row. `Enhancement Bonus` is ALSO refused, for a different reason: gear-planner spells it per slot (`(Weapon)` on 3,325 records, `(Armor)` on 1,234) while the wiki row says only '+2 Enhancement Bonus', so the sibling lookup misses and the slot-blind uniform fallback answers with a two-record Offhand spelling. Emitting that on 80 weapons would name a stat 3,325 weapons do not use. The refused lines stay in `raw` verbatim, so admitting them later needs no re-harvest.
